ADD-03/cover/para3.note: Bidders shall acknowledge receipt in Form 4-A. The cover summarises only; its other statements (e.g. a threshold of SAR 4,000,000 in Vol V 36.2) differ from the operative clause 2.1 and are reported in a separate issue.

ADD-03/4.1.new_text: If the Project Company encounters at the site ground conditions that are materially more adverse than those described in the Geotechnical Baseline Report, it shall be entitled to an extension of the Scheduled PCOD and to payment of its reasonable additional costs, provided that it notifies the Authority within five (5) Working Days of encountering them. In this Clause, the Geotechnical Baseline Report means Revision C of the report of that name issued by the Authority.

ADD-03/cover/para1/disp.reason: Issue date line only: 'Issued 17 November 2026'. It amends nothing and imposes nothing; it fixes the stage date.

ADD-03/cover/para2/disp.reason: Tender reference line only: 'Tender NUPA/ISTP/2026/014'. Identifies the tender; no amendment or obligation.

ADD-03/1.1/disp.reason: Recital stating the authority for issue and that the Addendum 'takes precedence over Addenda Nos. 1 and 2 in accordance with Volume I Clause 3.2'; it restates the existing Clause 3.2 order of precedence and edits no unit. A person confirms, since the words speak of precedence.

ADD-03/1.2/disp.reason: interpretive rule containing an exception ('unless otherwise stated'): 'A reference in this Addendum to a Clause, Table or Form is to that Clause, Table or Form as amended by Addenda Nos. 1 and 2, unless otherwise stated.' It bears on the base of ADD-03:2.1 (VOL-V:36.2 at ADD-02 is SAR 2,500,000) and conflicts with the cover figure; a person must confirm its effect.

ADD-03/1.3/disp.reason: Recital of fact that requests 15 to 19 were received in time under Volume I Clause 5.2; no amendment or obligation. (Whether receipt was in time is a factual claim for a person to check against VOL-I:5.2.)

ADD-03/2.1/disp.reason: ambiguous: 2.1 prints a change ('is reduced by SAR 1,000,000') to VOL-V:36.2, whose ADD-02 text states SAR 2,500,000, but the cover states the threshold becomes SAR 4,000,000. The two cannot both give the new figure; no op is proposed until a person decides. See the linked issue.

ADD-03/3.2.reason: Clarifies the numbering consequence of the relocation in 3.1 and prints no change of its own: 'The number 8.5 is not reused in Volume II, and the Clauses of Volume II are not renumbered.' No unit text changes; the vacancy of 8.5 is handled by ADD-03/3.1(b). A person confirms.

ADD-03/3.5.reason: A language-precedence statement ('The Arabic text governs') that amends no unit text by itself; which rendering governs is a person's decision (Legal). The rows 4 and 5 divergence is raised in ADD-03/3.5-issue.

ADD-03/AppA/para1/disp.reason: The paragraph states 'The Arabic text governs in accordance with Section 3.5 of this Addendum.' This is a precedence statement; which text prevails is a person's decision (Legal). Clause 3.5 is answered in another batch.

ADD-03/T42-1/image/r1/disp.reason: Row 1 of the governing Arabic Table 42-1 (civil and concrete structures: minimum residual life 20, maximum condition grade 2) is operative content that clause 3.4 makes part of Volume V Clause 42.1. Crop viewed: the row shows ١ / المنشآت المدنية والخرسانية / ٢٠ / ٢ and agrees with English row 1. The register row and the Volume V link belong with the clause 3.4 item; a person must confirm.

ADD-03/T42-1/image/r3/disp.reason: Row 3 of the Arabic Table 42-1 (mechanical equipment: 5 years, grade 3) is operative content made part of Volume V by clause 3.4; agrees with English row 3 as read from the page crop. Register row and Volume V link belong with the clause 3.4 item; a person confirms.

ADD-03/T42-1/image/notes-heading/disp.reason: Heading 'ملاحظات:' ('Notes:') only introduces the Arabic notes; it contains no obligation, exception or change. A person confirms.

ADD-03/T42-1/image/note1/disp.reason: Arabic note 1 defines how condition grade is assessed (Authority's five-point scale, grade 1 = new) and so gives meaning to the 'maximum condition grade' column. It is part of the Table's operative notes made part of Volume V by clause 3.4; the register row is for the clause 3.4 item and a person confirms. Matches English note (1).

ADD-03/T42-1/image/note2/disp.reason: Arabic note 2 says the Independent Engineer determines each asset's residual life in the pre-transfer condition survey; it allocates a determination and ties to the condition survey relocated to Volume V (other batch). Register row/dependency to be set with the clause 3.4 item; a person confirms. Matches English note (2).

ADD-03/T42-1/image/note3/disp.reason: Arabic note 3 obliges replacement, at the Project Company's cost before the transfer date, of any asset that does not meet the Table (matches English note (3)). It is an obligation with a cost consequence, part of Volume V via clause 3.4; the register row (consequence quoted from this note) and its link to the transfer date are for a person to confirm. Crop viewed: note 3 reads as quoted.

ADD-03/T42-1/image/signatory/disp.reason: Signature block title 'رئيس لجنة نقل الأصول' (Chairman, Asset Transfer Committee) identifies the signatory only; no obligation, exception or change. A person confirms.

ADD-03/T42-1/image/english/disp.reason: Letterhead/footer text on the page image (committee name and a fictional-document legend); it states no requirement, obligation or exception. A person confirms.

ADD-03/AppA/para2/disp.reason: 'End of reproduction.' only marks the end of Appendix A; no obligation, exception or change. A person confirms.

ADD-03/AppB/para1/disp.reason: Precedence statement: 'The Arabic text of Table 42-1 at Appendix A governs.' Which text governs is a person's decision (Legal); the paragraph also records the letter reference (No. 417/2026 dated 15 November 2026). Clause 3.5 is answered in another batch.

ADD-03/AppB/para2/disp.reason: This is the English qualifier of Table 42-1 ('shall be not less than stated below'), a convenience translation of the Arabic qualifier. It states an obligation (minimum residual life at the date of transfer) whose governing text is the Arabic; the register row is for the clause 3.4 item. Note also: cover/para3 says 'four asset classes' while Table 42-1 lists five rows; reported, not resolved (see issue).

ADD-03/T42-1/1/disp.reason: English convenience-translation row 1; agrees with Arabic row 1. Not governing per clause 3.5 (a person confirms); the register row follows the Arabic row and clause 3.4.

ADD-03/T42-1/3/disp.reason: English convenience-translation row 3; agrees with Arabic row 3. Not governing per clause 3.5 (a person confirms).

ADD-03/T42-1/notes/disp.reason: 'Notes to Table 42-1:' only introduces the notes; no obligation, exception or change. A person confirms.

ADD-03/T42-1/note(1)/disp.reason: English note (1), a convenience translation of Arabic note 1, defines the condition-grade scale; agrees with Arabic. Governing text is the Arabic (clause 3.5); a person confirms.

ADD-03/T42-1/note(2)/disp.reason: English note (2), a convenience translation of Arabic note 2, assigns determination of residual life to the Independent Engineer in the pre-transfer condition survey; agrees with Arabic. Governing text is the Arabic; a person confirms.

ADD-03/T42-1/note(3)/disp.reason: English note (3), a convenience translation of Arabic note 3: an obligation to replace non-compliant assets at the Project Company's cost before the transfer date. Agrees with Arabic note 3. The obligation row is for the clause 3.4 item; governing text is the Arabic; a person confirms.

ADD-03/AppB/para3/disp.reason: Signature block ('Signed: Chairman, Asset Transfer Committee ... (signature and stamp)') records who signed; no obligation, exception or change. A person confirms.

ADD-03/Q19.reason: The response defers to ADD-03:4.3 ('Section 4.3 of this Addendum applies. Requests made after the period stated in that Section will not be accommodated.'), which belongs to another batch. The three Working Day request period and its date rule are computed and registered with Section 4.3, and the exception to Volume I Clause 4.2 is in the same Section; Q19 adds no figure of its own. Not no_effect because the words oblige ('will not be accommodated'); to be reconciled with the 4.3 item.
